name: What usually goes wrong with tile flooring after installation?

mainEntity.name: What usually goes wrong with tile flooring after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are poor subfloor prep, moisture problems, and skipping movement joints. Those issues can lead to cracked tile, loose grout, hollow-sounding spots, and repairs that cost far more than doing the prep correctly the first time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most tile failures come from bad prep, moisture, or missing movement joints. Those problems can lead to cracks, loose grout, and expensive repairs.
